# Accepted Python dependency vulnerabilities.
#
# The dependency scan is a blocking CI gate. An entry here is a deliberate,
# reviewed exception — not a way to make a red build green. Every line needs:
#
#   <VULN-ID>   # YYYY-MM-DD, <who accepted it>, <why it does not apply here>,
#               # <what has to change before it can be removed>
#
# Review this file whenever the gate fails and at every release. An exception
# with no expiry is a permanent hole with extra steps, so state the condition
# that retires it. Prefer upgrading the dependency; an entry here is the
# fallback for a CVE with no fix available or one that provably cannot be
# reached from this codebase.
#
# Format is one pip-audit vulnerability id per line (GHSA-… or PYSEC-…).

# (empty — no accepted exceptions)
